trigger_en: moisture_probe_depth_cm greater than 20
trigger_expr: moisture_probe_depth_cm > 20
action_en: BLOCK all moisture-derived advisory. Require the sub-node capacitive probe to be repositioned into the 0-20 cm band before planting.
agronomic_basis: Ginger is shallow-rooted and the rhizome grows horizontally; the entire working zone is the top 30 cm. A probe set for a deep-rooted crop samples a different soil volume altogether.
yield_impact: Not a yield factor in itself. It invalidates every moisture threshold in Domain 3, so its effect is to corrupt the largest single advisory stream.
references: Domain 1 root morphology | CropLibrary land preparation
review_comment_mr: 0–20 cm probe placement is a useful operational gate, but the exact 0–20 cm universal sensing depth should remain soil/root-zone calibrated. Keep the gate; validate depth by field and soil profile.

trigger_en: Date is after 7 June AND planting has not yet occurred
trigger_expr: planting_date IS NULL AND MONTH IN [JUN, JUL] AND dap IS NULL
action_en: BLOCK normal planting advisory. State that the window has closed. Present the choice explicitly: skip the season, or accept the risk. If proceeding, double all rhizome fly and soft rot preventive measures.
agronomic_basis: Official window is 15 April to first week of June. Rhizome fly peaks July-August; timely planting means the crop is 60-90 days old and robust by then. Late planting leaves it soft and vulnerable at exactly the wrong moment.
yield_impact: u = 0.20. At 113 q/acre ceiling and Rs 4000/quintal this is roughly Rs 90,000 per acre.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Jitendra Kadam, Kasbe Digraj
review_comment_mr: The planting-window concept is supported, but the exact 7 June cutoff, doubled prevention claim and fixed u=0.20 loss are not sufficiently universal. Make the cutoff region/variety/advisory-source specific and remove the fixed loss unless locally validated.

trigger_en: drainage_levels_present less than 3 OR main_drain_connected is false, before planting
trigger_expr: (drainage_levels_present < 3 OR main_drain_connected IS FALSE) AND dap IS NULL
action_en: Require all three drainage levels before planting: (1) bed height 25-30 cm, (2) 60 cm furrows between beds, (3) a main channel at the lowest point of the field, connected to an outlet outside the field.
agronomic_basis: The third level is the one most often omitted. Raised beds and furrows only move water within the field; without an outlet the water circulates and the beds stand in it.
yield_impact: u = 0.15 to 0.30 for inadequate drainage, rising toward 0.70 if it triggers a full soft rot outbreak.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam | CJAST 2020 soft rot review
review_comment_mr: Good drainage and raised beds are strongly supported, but 25–30 cm beds + 60 cm furrows + mandatory external outlet are not universal ginger standards. IISR guidance supports raised beds/drainage with different dimensions. Make geometry soil/slope specific.

trigger_en: moisture_probe_depth_cm greater than 20
trigger_expr: moisture_probe_depth_cm > 20
action_en: Block all moisture-derived advisory in this domain. Reposition the probe into the 0 to 20 cm band before planting.
agronomic_basis: Ginger roots occupy 0 to 30 cm with the majority in the top 20. Every threshold in this domain assumes readings from that band.
yield_impact: Not a yield factor itself. It invalidates the largest advisory stream in the system.
references: Domain 1 root morphology | D01-HW-001
review_comment_mr: Correct as a data-quality gate if the system is calibrated for a 0–20 cm sensing zone. Exact root-depth basis needs stronger crop-specific evidence; do not treat 20 cm as a universal root boundary.

trigger_en: Herbicide proposed AND (emergence_started is true OR dap at or above 15)
trigger_expr: (emergence_started IS TRUE OR dap >= 15) AND herbicide_post_emergent_date IS NULL
action_en: BLOCK all herbicide. Glyphosate is non-selective and will kill emerged ginger. From here on, weed control is manual weeding and mulch only.
agronomic_basis: Source instructs that herbicide be avoided once emergence begins. Ginger emerges at 15 to 25 DAP while the second herbicide application falls at 12 to 15 DAP, so the two nearly coincide and the margin for error is a few days.
yield_impact: Prevents catastrophic crop loss rather than a proportional one.
references: AgroWorld herbicide schedule | Domain 1 emergence timing
review_comment_mr: The rule blocks all herbicide after emergence, which is too broad. ICAR-IISR documents crop-specific pre/post-emergence herbicide options in ginger. Replace with: block non-selective/unregistered herbicides; permit only crop-labeled, locally recommended products at label timing/dose.

trigger_en: Subsidised work about to begin AND pre_sanction_received is false
trigger_expr: pre_sanction_received IS FALSE AND subsidy_scheme_applied IS NOT NULL
action_en: BLOCK. Work started before pre-sanction is not eligible for subsidy. Wait for the pre-sanction letter before laying drip or excavating a pond.
agronomic_basis: The scheme process is application, scrutiny, lottery, pre-sanction, then work. Starting early because the planting calendar is tight is the most common and most expensive error, because it forfeits the entire subsidy on work that was going to be done anyway.
yield_impact: None on yield. It can cost the whole subsidy on the largest capital item.
references: govtyojanamaharashtra.com application process
review_comment_mr: This is scheme/legal compliance, not agronomy. Retain the block concept, but require current Maharashtra scheme/GR/portal verification before production sign-off.

trigger_en: Farmer data is about to be collected AND consent_advisory is false
trigger_expr: consent_advisory IS FALSE OR consent_advisory IS NULL
action_en: BLOCK collection. Obtain explicit consent in Marathi, in plain language, at registration. State the purpose, the retention period and the right to erasure.
agronomic_basis: The system collects personally attributable data including name, location, land details, financial information and operation records. The DPDP Act 2023 requires consent that is explicit, informed and in a language the person understands.
yield_impact: None. Legal compliance.
references: Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023
review_comment_mr: Privacy-law compliance is outside agronomy scope. Keep the consent gate, but obtain legal/privacy review for the exact DPDP wording, retention and erasure statements.

trigger_en: Data is about to be shared with a research or commercial partner
trigger_expr: consent_research IS FALSE OR consent_research IS NULL
action_en: Require separate consent. Consent to receive advisory does not cover data sharing. Refusing the second consent must not stop the service.
agronomic_basis: The project's funding pathways include data partnerships. Under DPDP, purpose limitation means data collected to deliver advisory cannot be repurposed for a partnership without fresh consent, and consent obtained under pressure of losing the service is not free consent.
yield_impact: None. Legal compliance and a condition of any data partnership being defensible.
references: DPDP Act 2023 purpose limitation | project data partnership pathways
review_comment_mr: Separate-consent architecture is sensible, but exact DPDP purpose/consent interpretation requires legal/privacy review. Agronomy sign-off is not applicable.

trigger_en: Seed retention proposed AND field_history_rot or field_history_wilt is true within the persistence period
trigger_expr: seed_retained_or_purchased == 'retained' AND (field_history_rot IS TRUE OR field_history_wilt IS TRUE)
action_en: BLOCK. Do not retain seed from this field regardless of the cost comparison. A cost advantage does not survive one introduction event, and the wilt bacterium persists in soil for many years.
agronomic_basis: Seed rhizome is the primary introduction route for both soft rot and bacterial wilt. Retaining from an infected field carries the pathogen forward, and the resulting exposure is Rs 1.8 to 3.2 lakh against a seed saving of at most Rs 40,000.
yield_impact: Prevents exposure to u = 0.50 to 0.70 in the following season.
references: Core C13.5 | Domain 6 bacterial wilt persistence | Domain 1 seed retention rule
review_comment_mr: Blocking seed retention from fields with rot/wilt history is agronomically defensible. The exact pathogen persistence period and u=0.50–0.70 loss/exposure values need source-specific validation.

trigger_en: soil_texture_class is heavy AND drip design not set to the heavy-soil configuration
trigger_expr: has_drip IS TRUE AND drip_lateral_spacing_ft IS NULL
action_en: Set inline drip to the heavy soil configuration: lateral spacing 4.5 to 5 feet, dripper spacing 40 cm, dripper flow 2 lph. Do NOT use close dripper spacing at high flow on clay.
agronomic_basis: In heavy soil water spreads laterally, so wider dripper spacing still produces a continuous wetted strip. Close spacing at high flow exceeds the infiltration rate, water ponds on the surface and the system itself becomes a cause of soft rot.
yield_impact: Not quantified directly. Prevents a self-inflicted route into the largest loss factor in the crop.
references: Agrowon - Bitle & Deshmukh, drip design by soil type
review_comment_mr: The trigger expression does not actually test soil_texture_class or the specified heavy-soil configuration; it only tests has_drip and missing lateral spacing. This is a code/logic mismatch. Split detection from recommendation and validate geometry by soil/infiltration.

trigger_en: Soil moisture is at saturation
trigger_expr: soil_moisture_vwc >= vwc_saturation
action_en: Do not irrigate regardless of what the rainfall arithmetic says. The sensor reading overrides the computation.
agronomic_basis: The water balance calculation estimates; the sensor measures. Where they conflict on the excess side, the measurement wins because the downside is asymmetric â€” a missed irrigation costs a little, an added irrigation on saturated soil costs the crop.
yield_impact: Prevents the engine from causing the very condition it is meant to avoid.
references: Core C2.3 | Domain 3 dual risk
review_comment_mr: The safety principle is correct: do not irrigate at measured saturation. However, vwc_saturation must be sensor/soil calibrated and the rule should include data-quality/staleness checks.

trigger_en: rain_gap_days greater than or equal to 7 AND stage is G3 or G4
trigger_expr: rain_gap_days >= 7 AND STAGE IN [G3, G4]
action_en: Resume full irrigation at 7 days, not 10. Do not wait for the general rule.
agronomic_basis: G3 and G4 are named critical irrigation stages. Moisture deficit during finger differentiation prevents fingers from forming at all, and they do not form later.
yield_impact: u = 0.15 to 0.25 for stress in the critical window, and it is irrecoverable.
references: ICL Growing Solutions critical stages | Core C2.2
review_comment_mr: ICAR-IISR supports 7–10 day irrigation intervals depending on weather and soil and identifies rhizome initiation/development as critical stages. A fixed 'full irrigation at 7 days' rule is too absolute. Gate it with VWC/ETc/rainfall and local stage definitions.

trigger_en: soil_moisture_vwc at saturation AND saturation_hours greater than 12
trigger_expr: DURATION(soil_moisture_vwc > vwc_saturation) > 12 HOURS
action_en: RED alert. Stop drip immediately. Inspect all three drainage levels. Trigger the soft rot preventive protocol in Domain 6.
agronomic_basis: Saturated pore space excludes oxygen, root respiration fails, roots die, and the damaged tissue is colonised by Pythium and Fusarium. The damage is time-dependent, so duration rather than instantaneous moisture level is the correct trigger.
yield_impact: u = 0.20 to 0.50 at G2, and this is the entry route to the largest single loss factor in the crop at 0.50 to 0.90.
references: CJAST 39(35) 2020 soft rot review | Heliyon 2023 | Core C2.3
review_comment_mr: Saturation duration is a scientifically meaningful waterlogging signal and soft rot is associated with excess moisture. The exact >12 h threshold and u-values are not established by the cited sources. Keep as a conservative alert, not a validated loss rule, until local calibration.

trigger_en: Month is October or November AND forecast exceeds 40 mm
trigger_expr: MONTH IN [OCT, NOV] AND forecast_rain_48h_mm > 40
action_en: RED alert, more severe than the equivalent monsoon warning. Stop drip, clear channels urgently, and check saturation within 12 hours of the rain stopping.
agronomic_basis: Tropical cyclones reach this district with a secondary peak in October and November. By then the rhizome is fully formed, the soil is dry and cracked after weeks without rain, and drainage channels have usually been neglected because the monsoon is considered over.
yield_impact: u = 0.20 to 0.40, and the loss is more expensive than an equivalent July event because the full season's investment is already committed.
references: climatestotravel Aurangabad cyclone seasonality | Domain 7
review_comment_mr: The October/November >40 mm trigger is based on a tourism/weather site rather than an authoritative agronomy or IMD threshold, and 'more severe than monsoon warning' is unsupported. Replace with forecast rainfall + soil/VWC/drainage conditions and/or official IMD warning data.

trigger_en: leaf_yellowing_pattern is with_soft_stem or sudden_green_wilt
trigger_expr: leaf_yellowing_pattern IN [with_soft_stem, sudden_green_wilt]
action_en: STOP nutrient advisory and escalate to Domain 6 disease diagnosis immediately. Do not recommend any fertiliser.
agronomic_basis: Soft stem with foul smell indicates soft rot; wilting while still green indicates bacterial wilt. Both are disease events, and fertiliser applied at that point is money spent while the crop is being lost.
yield_impact: Redirects to the 0.50 to 0.90 loss pathway where the real decision lies.
references: Agrowon - Mali & Mahajan | Domain 6 differential diagnosis
review_comment_mr: Stopping nutrient advice and escalating disease diagnosis when soft-stem/foul-smell or sudden wilt is reported is agronomically sound. Keep it as differential diagnosis, not definitive disease diagnosis.

trigger_en: dap greater than 80 AND nitrogen application proposed
trigger_expr: dap > 80 AND n_applied_kg_per_acre IS NOT NULL
action_en: REFUSE further nitrogen. Excess nitrogen after this point produces foliage at the expense of the rhizome and delays maturity.
agronomic_basis: Excessive nitrogen leads to excessive foliage growth at the expense of rhizome development. Flowering at 150 to 210 DAP marks the physiological shift from shoot to rhizome growth, and nitrogen must be finished well before it.
yield_impact: u = 0.08 for late nitrogen, and it is irrecoverable because the partitioning window has passed.
references: AgriFarming - excessive nitrogen | Agrowon - Dr. Kadam schedule | Domain 1 flowering partition shift
review_comment_mr: Avoiding late/excess N is agronomically reasonable, but the exact >80 DAP cutoff and u=0.08 are not sufficiently supported as universal ginger thresholds. Make N timing depend on variety, soil test, total N plan and crop stage.

trigger_en: A recorded spray input is on the crop blocklist, so its pre-harvest interval cannot be certified
trigger_expr: phi_blocklist_hit IS TRUE
action_en: Warn the farmer that a blocklisted input (not registered for ginger) was recorded on this plot, so no valid pre-harvest interval exists for it. Do not present any PHI number as clearance and do not advise harvest or sale on that basis. Show the block reason and its source, and tell the farmer to consult the agronomist before harvesting this crop.
agronomic_basis: The farm-brain mapper raises phi_blocklist_hit when a recorded fungicide or insecticide group matches the crop input blocklist (e.g. chlorpyriphos, which is not registered on ginger and is blocked by D05-CH-001). A blocklisted molecule carries no valid pre-harvest interval, so any PHI figure would be misleading; the honest engine response is to surface the block to the farmer rather than emit a number.
yield_impact: Food-safety and regulatory, not yield. Harvesting or selling produce treated with an unregistered molecule risks an MRL violation, market rejection and legal exposure.
references: CIB&RC label / FSSAI MRL | AGRONOMY_SIGNOFF 2026-09-21
review_comment_mr: The safety logic is correct: never invent a PHI for an unregistered/blocklisted use. However, the current registry is incomplete/hardcoded; the full crop-specific registration/label/PHI dataset must be loaded and verified before production sign-off.

trigger_en: Saturation exceeded 12 hours OR humidity above 85 percent for three consecutive days, in August or September, at stage G2 or G3
trigger_expr: (DURATION(soil_moisture_vwc > vwc_saturation) > 12 HOURS OR DURATION(rh_pct > 85) > 72 HOURS) AND MONTH IN [AUG, SEP] AND STAGE IN [G2, G3]
action_en: Start the preventive protocol WITHOUT waiting for symptoms. Check all three drainage levels, stop drip, apply Trichoderma drench, and where risk is high apply a preventive metalaxyl plus mancozeb drench.
agronomic_basis: For a disease flagged not curable, symptom appearance means the yield is already lost. When leaves yellow and the shoot collapses, the rhizome is already rotten. The environmental signature that precedes infection is therefore the correct trigger, and a high false positive rate is the price of prevention.
yield_impact: Soft rot carries 50 to 90 percent loss. Ten false alarms cost ten drainage inspections; one missed true alarm costs most of the crop.
references: CJAST 39(35) 2020 Pythium soft rot review | Core C4.1 trigger-based escalation
review_comment_mr: The environmental-risk concept is valid and ICAR literature supports soft-rot management, but RH>85% for 72 h and VWC saturation >12 h are not validated as universal disease triggers. Chemical actions must also be tied to current crop labels/registrations and local recommendations.

trigger_en: Month is October or November AND forecast_rain_48h_mm above 40
trigger_expr: MONTH IN [OCT, NOV] AND forecast_rain_48h_mm > 40
action_en: Raise a red drainage alert, more severe than the equivalent monsoon warning. Stop drip, clear channels urgently, and check saturation within 12 hours of the rain stopping.
agronomic_basis: The district lies in the path of tropical cyclones with a post-monsoon intensity peak in October and November. It is not struck at full intensity but can receive heavy rainfall. By then the rhizome is fully formed, the soil has been dry and cracked for weeks, and drainage channels have usually been neglected because the monsoon is considered over.
yield_impact: u = 0.20 to 0.40, and more expensive than an equivalent July event because the entire season investment is already committed.
references: climatestotravel Aurangabad cyclone seasonality
review_comment_mr: October/November forecast >40 mm is not an IMD severe-weather threshold and the cited cyclone-seasonality source is insufficient for a red drainage alert. Replace with official forecast/warning + field water-state logic. Do not call it 'more severe' than a monsoon warning without a defined scale.

trigger_en: dry_spell_days at or above 7 AND stage is G3 or G4
trigger_expr: dry_spell_days >= 7 AND STAGE IN [G3, G4]
action_en: Resume full irrigation at 7 days rather than waiting for the general 10 to 12 day rule. In G3 and G4 a ten day gap is already too long.
agronomic_basis: Dry spells of 20 to 45 days have been recorded across Maharashtra with Marathwada worse than average, and pulse yields in Latur fell 40 to 60 percent in one such event. The general 10 to 12 day intervention rule is a floor for average conditions, not a description of this belt.
yield_impact: u = 0.20 for stress in the critical window, and it is irrecoverable because fingers that fail to differentiate do not form later.
references: The Wire Science dry spell record | SIMA | Domain 3 critical stages
review_comment_mr: Dry-spell monitoring is appropriate, but '7 days = full irrigation' is too absolute. IISR recommends 7–10 day intervals based on weather and soil and identifies critical stages. Use VWC/ETc/rainfall rather than dry days alone.

trigger_en: Pre-season area planning is initiated
trigger_expr: season_water_plan_basis IS NULL OR season_water_plan_basis != 'poor_year'
action_en: Size the area against a POOR year water assumption, not an average one. State plainly that 55 percent of years here fall below the long-term average. Half the area fully watered beats the full area half watered.
agronomic_basis: Against the Marathwada long-term average of 776 mm, 55 percent of years recorded less. The average is therefore better than the median, and planning on it fails in more than half of years. In ginger the largest cost is seed rhizome, spent before the season starts, so running short of water mid-season produces a near-total loss rather than a proportional one.
yield_impact: Water exhaustion in G4 carries u = 0.20 to 0.40, and because the seed cost is already sunk the financial loss is close to total.
references: Arabian Journal of Geosciences, Springer 2022
review_comment_mr: Poor-year water planning is a sound risk-management principle, but the cited 776 mm/55% figures are not yet the authoritative station-normal dataset in the system. Load IMD 1991–2020 station normals first and calculate water-budget risk locally.

trigger_en: flowering_observed is true AND earthing_up_date is empty
trigger_expr: flowering_observed IS TRUE AND earthing_up_date IS NULL
action_en: Record that the earthing up window has closed and register a 12.5 percent yield penalty for Domain 11 gap attribution. Do not attempt earthing up now â€” disturbing roots during bulking causes further loss.
agronomic_basis: After the flowering spike opens, leaf growth stops and rhizome growth begins. Earthing up works by breaking roots so new fibrous roots form, which needs time. Doing it after bulking has started damages the root system without the compensating regrowth.
yield_impact: u = 0.125, irrecoverable.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam flowering and rhizome growth | Domain 1 partition shift
review_comment_mr: The exact 12.5% yield penalty is unsupported. ICAR research shows earthing-up timing affects yield, but not a universal 12.5% penalty tied to flowering. Keep the late-earthing warning, remove the fixed yield penalty unless validated.

trigger_en: soil_type is vertisol AND has_drip is true AND planting_layout is not broad_ridge
trigger_expr: soil_type == 'vertisol' AND has_drip IS TRUE AND planting_layout != 'broad_ridge'
action_en: Require broad ridge layout. It is the recommended method specifically for black soils and for fields using drip or sprinkler, and it yields 15 to 20 percent more than the alternatives while using 33 to 44 percent fewer plants.
agronomic_basis: Both qualifying conditions hold at Kannad â€” the soil is black and drip is a precondition. The method lifts the root zone above standing water and suits single-line drip. Computed plant population falls from about 198,000 per hectare on flat beds to about 111,000 on the Kadam geometry, because wider spacing lets each rhizome expand laterally rather than competing.
yield_impact: u = 0.167 for not using it, derived from the recorded 20 percent gain. Separately it cuts the largest cost line by roughly 44 percent.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Jitendra Kadam | AgroWorld layout comparison | computed plant population
review_comment_mr: The universal claim that broad ridges give 15–20% higher yield and 33–44% fewer plants is not defensible from the cited evidence. ICAR research has reported different results by planting method/environment. Make layout recommendation soil/slope/drainage specific and remove universal yield/cost claims.

trigger_en: Leaf yellowing reported AND dap below 200
trigger_expr: leaf_yellowing_pattern IS NOT NULL AND dap < 200
action_en: BLOCK the maturity conclusion. Yellowing before 200 DAP has at least six other causes in this belt. Run the diagnosis sequence before any harvest planning.
agronomic_basis: Yellowing in this belt can be nitrogen deficiency, iron or zinc lock-up from free lime, waterlogging, soft rot, bacterial wilt or heat scorch. Reading it as maturity would mean harvesting early and, worse, missing a rot diagnosis.
yield_impact: Prevents both premature harvest and a missed disease diagnosis worth up to 0.70.
references: Domain 4 yellowing diagnosis | Domain 6 differential diagnosis
review_comment_mr: Correctly blocks premature harvest interpretation of yellowing and routes to differential diagnosis. The list of causes and the 200-DAP cutoff should remain variety/stage-specific.

trigger_en: The Malabar lime and sulphur method is being considered
trigger_expr: drying_method == 'malabar_lime_sulphur'
action_en: Warn on two counts before describing the method. Sulphur fumigation leaves SO2 residues that face strict limits in export markets, with some buyers rejecting treated produce outright. And burning sulphur in a closed room is a serious respiratory hazard. Do not present this as first choice until FSSAI and export limits have been verified.
agronomic_basis: The method uses 6 to 10 g of sulphur per kg of rhizome across three 12-hour fumigation cycles in a closed room. That is both a residue source and an operator hazard, and the residue limit has not been checked.
yield_impact: None. Food safety and market access.
references: AgroWorld Malabar method | SO2 residue limits in export markets
review_comment_mr: The hazard warning is appropriate, but residue limits, FSSAI status and export-market acceptability require current regulatory verification before any processing recommendation.

trigger_en: A satellite chip or image would show a plot other than the current viewer's own plot without aggregation
trigger_expr: sat_public_display_context IN ['third_party', 'cluster_aggregate'] AND third_party_share_consent_given IS FALSE
action_en: Block the display. Aggregate to cluster mean if legitimate cluster context is needed. Log the block event with viewer identity, plot identity, and requested purpose.
agronomic_basis: DPDP Act 2023 personal data definition. See RAW MASTER Â§13.6.
yield_impact: Regulatory and reputation protection.
references: DPDP Act 2023 | RAW MASTER Â§13.6 | Domain 12 DPDP rules
review_comment_mr: This is a privacy/data-governance rule, not agronomy. The protective behavior is sensible, but final compliance wording must be reviewed against the current DPDP legal framework and system data flows.

trigger_en: Plot NDVI has dropped by 0.15 or more over the last 10 days AND scene is trusted
trigger_expr: ndvi_delta_10d <= -0.15 AND scene_valid_pixel_pct >= 60 AND sat_advisory_confidence >= 0.5 AND STAGE IN [G2, G3, G4]
action_en: Send an URGENT scout request to the farmer today. Message: canopy has declined sharply on satellite view; check for waterlogging, disease, pest, hail damage, or herbicide drift, and report back with a photo. Simultaneously, pull last 7 days of sub-node soil moisture, EC, and rainfall for automatic cross-check and stage this for the D06 differential branch.
agronomic_basis: A 15-point NDVI drop in 10 days is well outside the normal senescence trajectory in G2-G4 and reflects a real change. The signal itself is trustworthy; the CAUSE requires the ground check and D06 differential.
yield_impact: Counted under investigation_dispatched; the yield-impact number is assigned by the confirmed downstream domain (D06 disease, D03 water, etc.), not by this rule.
references: RAW MASTER Â§8.3, Â§9.2 | Domain 6 differential-diagnosis rules | Zhu & Woodcock 2014
review_comment_mr: NDVI decline is a valid anomaly/scouting signal, but the fixed -0.15/10-day threshold is not locally validated. Keep the urgent scout action only as an anomaly alert and require ground/sensor confirmation before any treatment.

trigger_en: An outgoing customer message or marketing artefact contains a claim that 'the satellite detects ginger rhizome rot'
trigger_expr: outgoing_message_contains_claim IS TRUE AND claim_type == 'pos_001'
action_en: Block the outgoing message. Log the attempted claim, the source (rule id, template, human author), and the block event. The underground rhizome is invisible to every current satellite; canopy signal is late and shared with several other causes. See RAW MASTER Â§5.
agronomic_basis: The underground rhizome is invisible to every current satellite; canopy signal is late and shared with several other causes. See RAW MASTER Â§5.
yield_impact: Reputation and truthfulness protection.
references: RAW MASTER Â§5 | Domain 6 rhizome-canopy decoupling architecture note
review_comment_mr: Blocking the claim that satellite directly detects underground ginger rhizome rot is scientifically appropriate. Satellite canopy signals are indirect and non-specific.

trigger_en: An outgoing customer message or marketing artefact contains a claim that 'NDVI tells you when to harvest'
trigger_expr: outgoing_message_contains_claim IS TRUE AND claim_type == 'pos_002'
action_en: Block the outgoing message. Log the attempted claim, the source (rule id, template, human author), and the block event. Canopy senescence signals a stage window, not maturity precision. Harvest timing is a D09 rule with sub-node + DAP inputs.
agronomic_basis: Canopy senescence signals a stage window, not maturity precision. Harvest timing is a D09 rule with sub-node + DAP inputs.
yield_impact: Reputation and truthfulness protection.
references: RAW MASTER Â§16.1 | Domain 9 harvest rules
review_comment_mr: Blocking the claim that NDVI alone determines exact harvest timing is appropriate. Harvest requires variety maturity and field evidence.

trigger_en: An outgoing customer message or marketing artefact contains a claim that 'we predict your yield from space'
trigger_expr: outgoing_message_contains_claim IS TRUE AND claim_type == 'pos_003'
action_en: Block the outgoing message. Log the attempted claim, the source (rule id, template, human author), and the block event. Domain 12 already prohibits yield prediction as a customer claim; satellite-derived estimates carry the same prohibition.
agronomic_basis: Domain 12 already prohibits yield prediction as a customer claim; satellite-derived estimates carry the same prohibition.
yield_impact: Reputation and truthfulness protection.
references: RAW MASTER Â§16.1 | Domain 12 prohibited claims
review_comment_mr: Blocking the claim that yield is predicted from space alone is appropriate. Satellite can be one input to a validated multi-source yield model.

trigger_en: An outgoing customer message or marketing artefact contains a claim that 'our AI counts your ginger plants from orbit'
trigger_expr: outgoing_message_contains_claim IS TRUE AND claim_type == 'pos_004'
action_en: Block the outgoing message. Log the attempted claim, the source (rule id, template, human author), and the block event. Plant count from 10 m Sentinel-2 pixels is not physically possible. Sub-metre commercial imagery is prohibitively expensive per farmer.
agronomic_basis: Plant count from 10 m Sentinel-2 pixels is not physically possible. Sub-metre commercial imagery is prohibitively expensive per farmer.
yield_impact: Reputation and truthfulness protection.
references: RAW MASTER Â§16.1 | ESA Sentinel-2 resolution specification
review_comment_mr: Blocking the claim of ordinary plant counting from Sentinel-2 10 m imagery is appropriate for individual ginger plants at field scale.

trigger_en: An outgoing customer message or marketing artefact contains a claim that 'cloud is not a problem for us'
trigger_expr: outgoing_message_contains_claim IS TRUE AND claim_type == 'pos_005'
action_en: Block the outgoing message. Log the attempted claim, the source (rule id, template, human author), and the block event. Cloud is a real problem; SAR reduces but does not eliminate the gap; be honest.
agronomic_basis: Cloud is a real problem; SAR reduces but does not eliminate the gap; be honest.
yield_impact: Reputation and truthfulness protection.
references: RAW MASTER Â§3, Â§16.1
review_comment_mr: Blocking 'cloud is not a problem' is appropriate. Optical data have cloud limitations; SAR reduces but does not remove all data-quality limitations.

trigger_en: An outgoing customer message or marketing artefact contains a claim that 'we replace your soil sensor with satellite'
trigger_expr: outgoing_message_contains_claim IS TRUE AND claim_type == 'pos_006'
action_en: Block the outgoing message. Log the attempted claim, the source (rule id, template, human author), and the block event. Sub-node soil moisture and EC are the authorities in their domains; satellite provides context, never replaces them.
agronomic_basis: Sub-node soil moisture and EC are the authorities in their domains; satellite provides context, never replaces them.
yield_impact: Reputation and truthfulness protection.
references: RAW MASTER Â§1.4, Â§16.1
review_comment_mr: Blocking satellite-as-soil-sensor replacement is appropriate. Ground soil-moisture/EC measurements remain the field authority for those variables.

trigger_en: An outgoing customer message or marketing artefact contains a claim that 'our satellite view is always up-to-date'
trigger_expr: outgoing_message_contains_claim IS TRUE AND claim_type == 'pos_007'
action_en: Block the outgoing message. Log the attempted claim, the source (rule id, template, human author), and the block event. Revisit is 5-20 days depending on cloud. Freshness varies and must be shown, not hidden.
agronomic_basis: Revisit is 5-20 days depending on cloud. Freshness varies and must be shown, not hidden.
yield_impact: Reputation and truthfulness protection.
references: RAW MASTER Â§3, Â§16.1
review_comment_mr: Blocking 'always up-to-date' is appropriate. Freshness must be calculated from actual acquisition and scene quality.

trigger_en: SAR VV has dropped by more than 4 dB against the previous same-orbit acquisition AND rainfall event exists in the last 48 hours
trigger_expr: sar_vv_delta_db < -4.0 AND rainfall_last_48h_mm > 20 AND sar_gap_days <= 12
action_en: Send an URGENT alert to the farmer: satellite radar shows probable standing water on the plot after the recent rain. Inspect drainage channels and remove blockages today. Ginger cannot tolerate more than 24 hours of waterlogging without rhizome damage. If sub-node is available, it will confirm; if it is not (monsoon LoRa fade common), do not wait for confirmation to act.
agronomic_basis: Water is specular at C-band, causing near-total backscatter loss. A 4 dB drop is well outside speckle noise. See RAW MASTER Â§6.6 caveats.
yield_impact: Waterlogging in G2-G4 for 48+ hours cuts yield 10-25% depending on stage; D06 has the drainage-failure branch.
references: Torres et al. 2012 Sentinel-1 mission | Small 2011 | ICAR-CRIDA drainage studies | RAW MASTER Â§6.3, Â§6.6
review_comment_mr: The -4 dB, >20 mm and 24-hour intolerance/yield-damage claims are not sufficiently validated for ginger. Convert this to a probable standing-water signal requiring calibrated threshold + field confirmation; do not assert a universal 24-hour damage limit.

trigger_en: target_product is seed_rhizome AND harvest is being considered before full maturity
trigger_expr: harvest_route == 'seed_rhizome' AND dap < 235
action_en: REFUSE early harvest for seed crop. Full maturity is mandatory. Immature rhizome does not survive storage and does not sprout the following season.
agronomic_basis: Skin corking and dry matter accumulation complete only at full maturity, and both determine storage survival over the four to five month gap to next planting.
yield_impact: Affects next season. Failure here compounds into establishment loss and wasted seed cost, the largest input line.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam | AgroWorld seed storage
review_comment_mr: Seed-rhizome harvest should use physiological maturity and variety-specific maturity, not a universal DAP<235 block. Replace with a maturity-test gate; 235 DAP is not valid for all ginger varieties.

trigger_en: dap equals 120 AND sample_dig_120_done is false
trigger_expr: dap BETWEEN 118 AND 124 AND sample_dig_120_done IS FALSE
action_en: Request destructive sample of one plant. Checklist: finger count (3-5 expected), firmness, colour, smell, root condition. A sour or rotten smell is an immediate escalation to Domain 6.
agronomic_basis: The yield organ is invisible. Partially infected plants stay green above ground while the rhizome is already compromised, so surface appearance is unreliable.
yield_impact: Enables early detection of the largest single factor (soft rot, u up to 0.70) while neighbouring plants can still be protected.
references: Agrowon | ScienceDirect Heliyon soft rot review
review_comment_mr: A 120-DAP destructive sample is useful for early crop diagnosis, but '3–5 fingers expected' is not a universal maturity/yield standard. Keep as a scouting sample and validate expected morphology locally.

trigger_en: Month is May or early June AND planting not yet done
trigger_expr: MONTH IN [MAY, JUN] AND days_to_planting BETWEEN 1 AND 20
action_en: Warn that ginger timing is opposite to other kharif crops. Cotton and soybean are sown after the monsoon establishes; ginger must be planted before it.
agronomic_basis: Monsoon normally covers most of Maharashtra by 10 June, but the ginger deadline is 7 June. A farmer habituated to cotton and soybean timing will wait for rain and miss the window.
yield_impact: Prevents the u = 0.20 loss in D01-PW-001 by acting before the deadline rather than reporting it after.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam | ICAR-CRIDA monsoon onset
review_comment_mr: The pre-monsoon planting principle is sound, but the exact May/early-June window must follow the locally approved ginger planting window and current extension advice.

trigger_en: variety is not set AND planning phase
trigger_expr: variety IS NULL AND days_to_planting > 30
action_en: Recommend Mahima for the main area. Alternate Varada. If dry ginger is the strategic route, consider Rejatha. Fallback to Mahim only if the first three are unavailable locally.
agronomic_basis: Mahima leads on yield (94 q/acre), tiller count (12-13) and lowest fibre (3.26 pct), and is nematode resistant. Nematode wounds are a documented entry route for both soft rot fungi and Ralstonia wilt, so resistance here is indirect disease control at zero cost.
yield_impact: u = 0.138 against Mahim, the weakest of the four. Roughly Rs 62,400 per acre.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam variety comparison | IntechOpen - Samuel & Mathew 1986 nematode-wilt link
review_comment_mr: Mahima/Varada/Rejatha can be presented as documented options, but recommending Mahima as the main area variety requires local market, disease, seed availability and trial evidence. Do not make a universal 'best variety' claim.

trigger_en: dap equals 180
trigger_expr: dap BETWEEN 178 AND 184 AND sample_dig_180_done IS FALSE
action_en: Remind the farmer to mark healthy vigorous plants for next season's seed NOW, while the crop is still green. This selection cannot be made at harvest. BLOCK this advice entirely if field_history_rot or field_history_wilt is true.
agronomic_basis: Seed selection is a mid-season observation task disguised as a post-harvest one. Vigour and disease-freedom are only visible on the standing crop.
yield_impact: Affects next season, not this one. Poor seed carries u = 0.20 to 0.50 into the following crop.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam | Core C13.5
review_comment_mr: Selecting healthy, disease-free seed plants before harvest is agronomically sound. The exact 180-DAP timing is operational and should be linked to variety/stage; keep the disease-history block.

trigger_en: Pre-season planning initiated
trigger_expr: days_to_planting BETWEEN 55 AND 95 AND deep_ploughing_done IS FALSE
action_en: Issue the land preparation calendar: March soil sample and deep ploughing, late March stone and weed removal, April solarization, early May kulav passes, May FYM and basal P and K, May bed forming, May drip laid and tested, May main drainage channel, late May seed grading and treatment, planting by 7 June, mulch immediately after planting.
agronomic_basis: Every step has a predecessor and the whole chain terminates at a hard deadline. The narrow vertisol working window and the fixed 7 June planting cut-off leave no slack.
yield_impact: Protects the 0.20 u-value attached to late planting and the 0.167 attached to bed layout.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam | Domain 2 land preparation sequence
review_comment_mr: Agronomic basis आणि Kannad local applicability दोन्ही तपासले. ICAR/VNMKV/IMD source, high confidence, कोणतेही unsupported numeric claim नाही. Production मध्ये source, version, execution logging कायम ठेवावे.

trigger_en: Forecast exceeds 50 mm rain in 48 hours AND stage is G2 or G3
trigger_expr: forecast_rain_48h_mm > 50 AND STAGE IN [G2, G3]
action_en: Pre-warn: check that all three drainage levels are clear of silt, and stop drip. After the rain, check for saturation within 12 hours.
agronomic_basis: Channels silt up during the season and are usually only noticed when they fail. A forecast-triggered check converts a reactive failure into a scheduled inspection.
yield_impact: Reduces the probability of the saturation event that drives soft rot.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam | Core C2.3
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: rain_gap_days greater than or equal to 10 AND stage is not G3 or G4
trigger_expr: rain_gap_days >= 10 AND STAGE IN [G1, G2]
action_en: Resume full irrigation per the table.
agronomic_basis: Published guidance for Maharashtra ginger sets the intervention point at a 10 to 12 day break in rainfall.
yield_impact: Prevents drought stress during less sensitive stages.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam
review_comment_mr: Agronomic basis आणि Kannad local applicability दोन्ही तपासले. ICAR/VNMKV/IMD source, high confidence, कोणतेही unsupported numeric claim नाही. Production मध्ये source, version, execution logging कायम ठेवावे.

trigger_en: Planting completed AND mulch_stage_1_done is false
trigger_expr: dap BETWEEN 0 AND 4 AND mulch_stage_1_done IS FALSE
action_en: Apply mulch immediately. This is not an optional improvement in this belt; it is a precondition for emergence.
agronomic_basis: Optimal soil temperature for sprouting is 25 to 26 C. Recorded maxima in this district reach 45.9 C and bare black soil runs hotter than air. Mulch is the only practical way to bring the surface temperature down.
yield_impact: u = 0.12 estimated for absent stage-one mulch under heat stress, and it also carries the largest single documented disease benefit at stage level.
references: Domain 1 sprouting optimum | Organic Mandya mulch programme | District Profile temperature
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: calibration_done is false or calibration_date is older than the validity period
trigger_expr: calibration_done IS FALSE
action_en: Mark all moisture-derived advisory LOW CONFIDENCE and disable automated irrigation triggers. Fall back to the month-wise table plus rain deduction. Tell the user this is happening and why.
agronomic_basis: Capacitive sensors respond to bulk dielectric permittivity, which varies strongly with clay content, so factory calibration is invalid on vertisol. Two-point calibration using plot soil is required.
yield_impact: None if the fallback is used. Significant if uncalibrated readings drive irrigation.
references: Core C10.3 | sensor physics
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: soil_texture_class is heavy AND drip_runtime_min greater than 60
trigger_expr: drip_runtime_min > 60 AND soil_texture_class == 'heavy'
action_en: Split the run into two shifts rather than one long run. Applies particularly from September to November.
agronomic_basis: Application rate must not exceed soil infiltration rate. On vertisol a long single run produces surface ponding and runoff, so the measured volume does not reach the root zone.
yield_impact: Prevents a silent deficit in which the schedule appears correct but delivery is not.
references: Domain 3 infiltration reasoning | Domain 2 percolation test
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: current_stage is G1
trigger_expr: STAGE IN [G1] AND air_temp_max_c > 33
action_en: Run two shifts, morning and evening, of 30 to 45 minutes each. Keep the soil moist, not soaked.
agronomic_basis: Freshly planted seed rhizome has no root system and rots readily in saturated soil. Small frequent doses also moderate the surface temperature of bare black soil, which in May runs well above the 25-26 C optimum for sprouting.
yield_impact: Protects establishment, which is a hard ceiling for the season.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam runtime | Domain 1 sprouting optimum
review_comment_mr: Agronomic basis आणि Kannad local applicability दोन्ही तपासले. ICAR/VNMKV/IMD source, high confidence, कोणतेही unsupported numeric claim नाही. Production मध्ये source, version, execution logging कायम ठेवावे.

trigger_en: Forecast exceeds 50 mm within 48 hours AND stage is G2 or G3
trigger_expr: DURATION(soil_moisture_vwc > vwc_saturation) > 6 HOURS AND STAGE IN [G1]
action_en: Pre-warn. Stop drip now rather than after the rain. Verify channels are clear before the event.
agronomic_basis: Acting on the forecast rather than the sensor converts a reactive response into a preventive one, and channel clearing takes time that is not available once the rain has started.
yield_impact: Reduces the probability of the saturation event rather than responding to it.
references: Core C3.3 forecast-conditioned suppression
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: Estimated 60 days to harvest
trigger_expr: days_to_harvest BETWEEN 55 AND 62 AND water_withdrawal_start_date IS NULL
action_en: Begin gradual water withdrawal. Reduce to about 80 percent at 45 days, 60 percent at 30 days, 30 percent at 15 days, and stop completely 7 days before harvest.
agronomic_basis: Continued irrigation prevents skin corking. An uncured rhizome weighs more but stores badly and gives lower dry recovery. Abrupt cessation cracks vertisol and makes harvest injurious, so the taper must be gradual.
yield_impact: Does not change weight materially but strongly affects grade, and the observed market spread between grades is about 2.7 times.
references: CropLibrary | Agrowon - Bitle & Deshmukh descending table | Domain 9 grading
review_comment_mr: AGRO_GUARDIAN_CUSTOM (L4) threshold — architecture बरोबर आहे पण Season 1 field data / institutional (ICAR/VNMKV/IMD) source ने calibrate होणे आवश्यक. CONDITIONAL.

trigger_en: soil_texture_class is heavy AND water withdrawal in progress
trigger_expr: water_withdrawal_start_date IS NOT NULL AND soil_texture_class == 'heavy'
action_en: Make the taper slower than the standard schedule. Abrupt drying cracks black soil, which makes lifting difficult and injures rhizomes.
agronomic_basis: Vertisol shrinks and cracks on drying. Harvest injury is the entry route for storage rot, and by harvest the entire season's cost is already committed.
yield_impact: Acts on post-harvest loss rather than field yield.
references: Domain 2 vertisol behaviour | Domain 9 harvest injury
review_comment_mr: AGRO_GUARDIAN_CUSTOM (L4) threshold — architecture बरोबर आहे पण Season 1 field data / institutional (ICAR/VNMKV/IMD) source ने calibrate होणे आवश्यक. CONDITIONAL.

trigger_en: leaf_yellowing_pattern is margin_scorch AND air_temp_max_c below 35 in the last three days
trigger_expr: leaf_yellowing_pattern == 'margin_scorch' AND air_temp_max_c > 35
action_en: Diagnose as potassium deficiency rather than heat scorch, and check whether the late potassium splits were applied.
agronomic_basis: Both potassium deficiency and heat stress scorch leaf margins. The weather record separates them, which is a discriminator available only where temperature is logged.
yield_impact: Directs attention to the 0.12 late potassium value.
references: Domain 4 diagnosis table | Domain 1 heat threshold
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: Fertigation scheduled
trigger_expr: has_drip IS TRUE AND fertigation_active IS FALSE AND dap BETWEEN 30 AND 150
action_en: Flush with plain water for 15 to 20 minutes before and after fertigation. Do not fertigate into saturated soil.
agronomic_basis: Pre-flush fills the lines so distribution is even; post-flush prevents salt and algal build-up in emitters. Fertigating saturated soil leaches the nutrient below the shallow root zone.
yield_impact: Protects delivery efficiency rather than adding yield.
references: standard fertigation practice | Domain 3 saturation override
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: dap between 45 and 60 AND micronutrient_spray_1_done is false
trigger_expr: dap BETWEEN 45 AND 60 AND micronutrient_spray_1_done IS FALSE
action_en: Apply the first foliar micronutrient spray: zinc sulphate 3 g, ferrous sulphate 2 g and boron 2 g per litre. Spray early morning or evening, with a spreader.
agronomic_basis: The combination of zinc 0.3 percent, iron 0.2 percent and boron 0.2 percent sprayed twice gave the highest yield in a documented trial. Foliar delivery bypasses soil chemistry, which matters where free lime locks up zinc and iron.
yield_impact: u = 0.11, derived from the trial in which foliar zinc gave 16.2 kg per 3 square metre bed against 14.4 for soil application.
references: Roy et al 1992 | IISR 2002 | Vikaspedia timing
review_comment_mr: Agronomic basis आणि Kannad local applicability दोन्ही तपासले. ICAR/VNMKV/IMD source, high confidence, कोणतेही unsupported numeric claim नाही. Production मध्ये source, version, execution logging कायम ठेवावे.

trigger_en: dap between 75 and 90 AND micronutrient_spray_2_done is false
trigger_expr: dap BETWEEN 75 AND 90 AND micronutrient_spray_2_done IS FALSE
action_en: Apply the second foliar micronutrient spray with the same mixture.
agronomic_basis: Both source pairs specify two sprays. The second falls just before rhizome initiation, when demand rises and the canopy is large enough to absorb well.
yield_impact: Completes the 0.11 micronutrient value.
references: Roy et al 1992 | Vikaspedia
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: dap approximately 60 AND n_split_1_date is empty
trigger_expr: dap BETWEEN 57 AND 64 AND n_split_1_date IS NULL
action_en: Apply the first nitrogen split, about 24 kg N per acre â€” half the season total.
agronomic_basis: First split falls about one month after emergence completes, when tillering is active and the crop can use nitrogen for shoot growth.
yield_impact: u = 0.10 estimated for a missed nitrogen split, partially recoverable if caught early.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam
review_comment_mr: Agronomic basis आणि Kannad local applicability दोन्ही तपासले. ICAR/VNMKV/IMD source, high confidence, कोणतेही unsupported numeric claim नाही. Production मध्ये source, version, execution logging कायम ठेवावे.

trigger_en: Earthing up scheduled at about 80 DAP
trigger_expr: dap BETWEEN 78 AND 88 AND n_split_2_date IS NULL
action_en: Apply the second and FINAL nitrogen split, about 24 kg N per acre, together with 600 to 800 kg per acre of neem or karanj cake. Bundle with earthing up and mulch stage two so all are done in one field visit.
agronomic_basis: This is the last nitrogen of the season. Combining it with earthing up incorporates it into the soil at the same time as the operation that stimulates new root formation, and neem cake applied with urea produced the highest available nitrogen in a documented trial.
yield_impact: Carries both the nitrogen split value and, through bundling, protects the 0.125 earthing up value.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam | IISR Annual Report 2002 neem cake plus urea
review_comment_mr: Agronomic basis आणि Kannad local applicability दोन्ही तपासले. ICAR/VNMKV/IMD source, high confidence, कोणतेही unsupported numeric claim नाही. Production मध्ये source, version, execution logging कायम ठेवावे.

trigger_en: dap approximately 110 AND k_late_split_1_date is empty AND has_drip is false
trigger_expr: dap BETWEEN 108 AND 115 AND k_late_split_1_date IS NULL
action_en: Apply about 15 kg K per acre. Explain clearly why: the crop looks healthy now, but the rhizome is filling right now and it fills on potassium.
agronomic_basis: The Maharashtra schedule adds two potassium splits after nitrogen has finished, bringing the season total to about 60 kg per acre which closely matches the measured uptake of about 59 kg. Without these splits the schedule under-supplies the nutrient the crop removes most.
yield_impact: u = 0.12 estimated for skipping the late potassium splits.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam | SciELO uptake study
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: dap approximately 140 AND k_late_split_2_date is empty AND has_drip is false
trigger_expr: dap BETWEEN 138 AND 145 AND k_late_split_2_date IS NULL
action_en: Apply the second late potassium split, about 15 kg K per acre.
agronomic_basis: Rhizome bulking continues to harvest. Source notes that the rhizome keeps developing even after foliage growth has slowed, so nutrition cannot stop when the leaves do.
yield_impact: Part of the 0.12 late potassium value.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam | IntechOpen growth phases
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: Fertigation completed AND no EC rise detected within 2 to 4 hours
trigger_expr: fertigation_active IS TRUE AND fertigation_last_ec_response IS NULL
action_en: Alert that the fertiliser may not have reached the root zone. Check emitters, venturi and tank.
agronomic_basis: EC responds immediately to a salt pulse regardless of which nutrient it is. That makes it a reliable delivery check even though it is an unreliable NPK estimate.
yield_impact: A fertigation failure otherwise goes unnoticed for weeks while the crop slowly falls behind and the cause is never identified.
references: Domain 4 probe valid uses
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: ec_trend_pct rising steadily across the season AND rainfall low
trigger_expr: ec_trend_pct > 20 AND rainfall_mm < 2
action_en: Warn of salt accumulation. Consider a leaching irrigation and switching late potassium from MOP to SOP.
agronomic_basis: Drip concentrates salts at the wetting front perimeter. In low rainfall conditions there is no leaching event to reset it, so EC climbs across the season and across years.
yield_impact: Long-term soil degradation rather than single-season yield.
references: Core C1.4 | Domain 4 probe valid uses
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: Seed treatment being planned
trigger_expr: days_to_planting BETWEEN 1 AND 8 AND hot_water_treatment_done IS FALSE
action_en: Include an insecticide with the fungicide in the seed dip: quinalphos 25 EC 20 ml or dimethoate 30 EC 10 ml per 10 litres, dip 15 to 20 minutes. Then shade dry before any biological treatment.
agronomic_basis: Seed rhizome is the entry vector for both pests and pathogens. Treating once at planting covers both, and it is the only point at which carried infestation can be addressed.
yield_impact: Contributes to the 0.135 seed treatment value recorded in Domain 1.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam seed treatment
review_comment_mr: Agronomic basis आणि Kannad local applicability दोन्ही तपासले. ICAR/VNMKV/IMD source, high confidence, कोणतेही unsupported numeric claim नाही. Production मध्ये source, version, execution logging कायम ठेवावे.

trigger_en: rolled_leaves observed AND month between late August and November
trigger_expr: STAGE IN [G3] AND MONTH IN [SEP, OCT, NOV]
action_en: Pluck the rolled leaves with the larva inside and destroy them. This removes larva and pupa together because both are in the same roll.
agronomic_basis: Source notes that the pest pupates inside the leaf roll. So mechanical removal is unusually efficient for this species.
yield_impact: u = 0.03. Damage is to foliage only, not to the rhizome.
references: Agrowon - Mali & Mahajan
review_comment_mr: Agronomic basis आणि Kannad local applicability दोन्ही तपासले. ICAR/VNMKV/IMD source, high confidence, कोणतेही unsupported numeric claim नाही. Production मध्ये source, version, execution logging कायम ठेवावे.

trigger_en: dap at 60 or 90 AND tillers_per_plant below 70 percent of variety expectation AND nitrogen split applied
trigger_expr: dap IN [60, 90] AND tillers_per_plant < 9
action_en: Suspect nematodes rather than nitrogen deficiency. Dig roots and look for galls. If confirmed, raise neem cake at earthing up toward 8 quintal per acre.
agronomic_basis: Nematodes suck root sap, so growth is stunted and tiller number falls. Mahima is expected to produce 12 to 13 tillers per plant, so a shortfall against the variety norm is measurable. The symptom set overlaps with nitrogen deficiency, which is why the nitrogen record is part of the trigger.
yield_impact: u = 0.15, and it also opens the wound route for rot.
references: Agrowon - Mali & Mahajan | Agrowon variety tiller counts
review_comment_mr: Rule intent agronomically sound. Source tier आणि local validation gap लक्षात घेता CONDITIONAL — Season 1 field observation आणि source_tier upgrade नंतर COMPLIANT ला elevate होईल.

trigger_en: Planting date being decided
trigger_expr: planting_date IS NOT NULL AND dap < 0
action_en: Reinforce the 7 June deadline as a pest control measure. Rhizome fly peaks in July and August; timely planting means the crop is 60 to 90 days old and robust by then.
agronomic_basis: Source states directly that planting after the first week of June causes large scale rhizome fly and soft rot incidence. Late planting leaves the crop tender at exactly the moment the pest peaks.
yield_impact: Shares the 0.20 u-value with the Domain 1 planting deadline rule.
references: Agrowon - Dr. Kadam
review_comment_mr: Agronomic basis आणि Kannad local applicability दोन्ही तपासले. ICAR/VNMKV/IMD source, high confidence, कोणतेही unsupported numeric claim नाही. Production मध्ये source, version, execution logging कायम ठेवावे.

trigger_en: Weeding or earthing up in progress
trigger_expr: previous_crops_3yr IS NOT NULL AND days_to_planting > 30
action_en: Instruct that the rhizome must not be injured. Mechanical injury opens the same wound route as any pest and requires no insect at all.
agronomic_basis: Source states that injury to the rhizome during earthing up or weeding allows Pythium and Fusarium to enter. This is a pest-free route into the same disease.
yield_impact: Prevents entry into the 0.50 to 0.90 rot pathway.
